english.note: Use this for loose crumbs of cake or biscuits, or for tiny fragments of other solid materials when a food-specific term is not being used.

examples.english: After eating a biscuit, I had a crumb stuck to my shirt.
examples.traditional: 食完曲奇，我件衫黐咗一粒碎屑。
